definition.text: Son of Saba, the surname (1) of Joseph, also called Justus (Acts 1:23), some identify him with Barnabas; (2) of Judas, who was a “prophet.” Nothing more is known of him than what is mentioned in Acts 15:32.

works.title: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series 2, Volume 1: Eusebius — Church History, Life of Constantine, Oration in Praise of Constantine
